Improvements: Optimized day / night lighting code. Instead of updating every frame, the lightning now updates only when the hour changes. This should greatly improve performance
Camera collisions are now instant instead of damping, this works similar to Dark Souls and improves visibility whenever the camera colliders with objects
Additions: Added a new area in Maerimond Cavern near the boss room where you can access expansion content for Whispering Vale. This will be the room for future expansions as well related to Maerimond storyline continuation.
Added a new expansion: The Whispering Vale
Added a new huge map to explore: The Whispering Vale and the Forest Temple
Added a new boss fight with secret mechanics
Added a cavern system, allowing for lighting and music to change whenever we enter / exit caverns
Fixes: Fixed a bug where AI would not take damage after dodging
Fixed enemies sliding between idle - patrol - chase states
Fixed a bug where throwing fire bombs and being interrupted would cause enemies to still hold the fire bomb graphic
